propositions: Plan review must return deterministic BLOCK with coverage.llm_ran=false before any LLM call when ticket description exceeds 8,000 characters.
Completion verification must return deterministic FAIL with zero runner calls when authoritative ticket description exceeds 8,000 characters.
Description of exactly 8,000 characters is admitted; 8,001 characters is blocked.
Light bug review retains blocking P4 description finding while downgrading other DET blocks to advisory.
AC-count and file-impact P4 signals remain advisory; neither gate truncates or elides ticket content to get under the limit.
